digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend port / vendor adapter seam
propositions: Four core modules (fetcher, applier, apply_handlers, _attestation) have function-nested imports from adapters.jira that must be eliminated to satisfy ADR 0035 §(d) vendor adapter seam constraints

Backend protocol must expose scalar, read-only translation-only members (project, query_project, assert_env_ready) with neutral exception types (BackendEnvError, BackendAssigneeNotFoundError) that JiraBackend implements via resolve_jira_settings delegation

Fetcher and applier have divergent project scoping semantics (un-defaulted fail-closed vs. DIG-defaulted cross-project guard) that must be preserved and unified through distinct query_project and project accessors

AST gate in test_backend_neutrality.py must use full-tree ast.walk to detect nested function-scoped imports in the four modules, since top-level-only _module_level_imported_names helper is insufficient

Environment readiness fail-fast for JIRA_URL/JIRA_USER/JIRA_API_TOKEN attestation must be moved into neutral BackendEnvError raised from assert_env_ready() so every backend implementor has standardized contract
Assignee resolution failures must route through neutral BackendAssigneeNotFoundError exception defined in _backend.py, with JiraBackend subclass preserving soft-fail semantics in apply_handlers
